title: The ledger misses the start of many agents
what: The ledger misses the start of many agents
why: Measured 27 Oct by the speed design: relay's agent cost log (the ledger) holds 161 agent stops for that day but only 87 agent_start events, so 76 agents have no start; idle time and per-stage wall time cannot be computed from it (the design had to read the workflow transcripts instead).
failing_case: For 27 Oct, count agent_stop vs agent_start lines in the ledger: 161 vs 87.
pass_cases: Every agent the ledger records as stopped has a start event, workflow agents included.
A test feeds a workflow agent's hook input and finds both events.
The test fails with the start recording disabled.
where: the ledger hooks under plugins/ (agent start)
